user_query: I'm organizing a virtual conference for my company and I need to generate unique QR codes for each participant. The QR codes should contain their names and email addresses. Can you assist me with this? Also, I would like to check if our company website has any archived versions on the Wayback machine. Please provide the available snapshots from 2010 to 2022. Thank you!

TaskList.description: Collect participants' names and email addresses for the virtual conference.
Generate unique QR codes for each participant containing their name and email address.
Check the Wayback Machine for archived versions of the company website from 2010 to 2022.
